sn29.10:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu, bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
sn29.10:1.3: ko nu kho bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā opapātikānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī”ti.
sn29.10:2.5: “aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā opapātikānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya”nti.
sn29.10:2.6: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā opapātikānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
sn29.10:2.7: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā opapātikānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
